title: The room's mark on its jamb: M1 a chalk X, M2 a chemlight, made by the last man out
about: v0.0.20 (the build sheet's item 12; question 7): leaving a room, the last man out marks it on the latch-side jamb, 0.3 m outward of the door's plane and 1.5 m up, from his hand's stroke on (nothing pops in): your #2 as he passes the door, you where he went out first. Two looks, drawn by the game's own code (src/render/range-items.js jambMarks) at 16 px/m: M1 a chalk X, lit by the light where it is, as chalk is; M2 a chemlight taped to the jamb, which glows through the fog. Each seen from the hall, face on, with a marine's head height dotted for scale, lit and in the dark. The game draws M1 until you pick.
